Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr Unush Khan, Mr S Das
Advocate for the Respondent : Dy.S.G.I., Sc, Health
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Medhi
 Order
28.08.2024 . 
Heard Shri U Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner, who is aggrieved by the exclusion of the Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine & Surgery (BHMS) from the purview of the recruitment for the post of Food Safety Officer initiated vide the advertisement dated 31.10.2023.
It is the case of the petitioner that the expression "Degree in medicine" should be interpretated to include BHMS degree. 
Let notice be issued, returnable by 6 weeks. 
Ms. B Sarma, learned CGC accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1 whereas Shri B Gogoi,
learned Standing Counsel, Health Department, Assam accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 4, 5, 6, 7, 9 and 10. 
Extra copies of the writ petition along with annexures be served upon the learned counsel for the respondents within 2 days. 
Page No.# 5/5 Steps for service of notice upon the respondent nos. 2, 3, 8 and 11 be taken by registered post with A/D within 2 days.
